email.subject: Quick fix for Lighthouse Pros' site
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I looked at the Lighthouse Pros Dentistry site. Two things are likely costing you patients: there's no way to book online, so anyone visiting outside office hours has to call and wait or just leaves, and your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people can't tell if you're open before showing up or calling.

I fix these for local businesses for a flat fee. Happy to walk you through what I found, no obligation, 10 minutes on a call or video.

Would Thursday or Friday work?

Alex
Northlight Web
